title: TailSteer: Trajectory-Tail Steering for Drift-Resistant Multi-turn Image Editing
abstract: arXiv:2611.06741v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Strong single-turn editing performance does not guarantee reliable multi-turn interaction: as edited outputs are repeatedly reused, small unintended changes can accumulate into severe visual drift. This long-term drift is often mitigated through training on multi-turn data or cross-turn rollouts, potentially altering pretrained priors, or through specialized inference-time mechanisms that are difficult to scale to foundation models. We introduce TailSteer, a final-stage training framework that improves multi-turn robustness while retaining the generative and editing capabilities acquired through earlier training. TailSteer follows a simple principle: keep early denoising dynamics close to those of the base model and concentrate preservation corrections near the trajectory tail, where fine-grained deviations can be suppressed. translated_title: TailSteer：面向抗漂移多轮图像编辑的轨迹尾部引导
translated_abstract: 强大的单轮编辑性能并不能保证可靠的多轮交互：随着编辑输出被反复复用，微小的非预期变化会不断累积，最终演变为严重的视觉漂移。这种长期漂移通常通过对多轮数据或跨轮rollout进行训练来缓解，但这可能会改变预训练先验；或者借助难以扩展到基础模型的专用推理时机制。我们提出了TailSteer，一个最终阶段的训练框架，它能在提升多轮鲁棒性的同时，保留早期训练所获得的生成与编辑能力。TailSteer遵循一个简单的原则：保持早期去噪动力学接近基础模型，并将保真校正集中在轨迹尾部附近，从而抑制细粒度的偏差。这些校正从编辑器自身的在策略去噪rollout中学习，使用未发生变化的源内容……
tldr: TailSteer通过在去噪轨迹尾部集中施加保真校正（该校正从模型自身的在策略rollout中学习），在不改变早期去噪动力学和预训练先验的前提下，有效抑制多轮图像编辑中累积的视觉漂移。
en_tdlr: TailSteer is a final-stage training framework that suppresses visual drift in multi-turn image editing by concentrating preservation corrections—learned from on-policy denoising rollouts—at the trajectory tail, while keeping early denoising dynamics and pretrained priors unchanged.
